name: web-swot-diagram-cream-bold-geometric-shapes
title: Cream SWOT diagram with bold geometric shape accents
whatItIs: A cream-background SWOT quadrant diagram labeled with rounded dark letter badges, decorated with abstract bold geometric shape clusters (starbursts, arches, dots) instead of literal icons.
whatItMeans: Replacing typical corporate icon sets with purely abstract shape clusters gives a standard business-analysis template a distinct, non-generic art-directed identity.
techniques: label a quadrant framework with rounded letter badges instead of full word headers for a cleaner grid
decorate with abstract geometric shape clusters rather than literal topic icons
keep decorative shapes clustered at diagram corners so they frame rather than compete with the content

vocabulary.definition: a strategic planning framework evaluating Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats
